caption: The drawing depicts a single large, rounded, urn-shaped jug with two curved handles attached symmetrically near the neck, which converge toward a short, narrow opening at the top. The vessel is rendered in a predominately earthy greenish-brown color, featuring irregular, darker, vertical streaks and smudges running from the top to the bottom, giving the appearance of glaze drips or natural discoloration. The jug has a circular base and a patterned marking or symbol near the upper center portion of the body. The object is centered against a plain, off-white background, and the artist's signature "Annie B. Johnston" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Stoneware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
